Northstar Analytics — 2027 renewal brief
Prepared by Procurement for the operations review board.

Northstar Analytics provides the reporting platform used by the operations team.
This brief covers the third renewal of the master agreement signed in 2024 and
is circulated ahead of the notice deadline.

Vendor: Northstar Analytics
Annual renewal fee USD: 52500
Renewal date: 2027-04-01
Renewal posture: automatic
Notice period days: 60
Security assurance: SOC 2 Type II report requested, 2026 report not yet received
Hosting region: United States

Amendment circulated after the vendor call:
The vendor confirmed that the commercial schedule governs, so the renewal date
stays 2027-04-01 and the signature page will be reissued. The uplift and the
longer notice period are reflected above.
